title: Defense witness: No reason for Cale88 income to go beyond P208M
summary: The defense witness from the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte said Friday there was no reason for Cale88 Foods Corporation to surpass its…

blocks.text: FROM 2022 TO 2025
Published November 20, 2026 5:25pm

The defense witness from the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte said Friday there was no reason for Cale88 Foods Corporation to surpass its declared sales of P208 million during the years 2022 to 2025.

On Day 45 of the impeachment trial, Senator-judge and Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian asked DTI Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo about Cale88, the food company linked to Duterte's husband Manases Carpio.
"From 2022 to 2025, ang audited sales ng Cale88 is P208 million, tama po ba (is that correct)?" Gatchalian said, citing DTI documents.
"Opo (Yes), honorable judge," Rodolfo replied.
Gatchalian then presented data from the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC), which showed that Cale88 had an inflow of P776 million compared to an outflow of P154.611 million.

"Ang inward remittance is about P776 million… sa inyong karanasan, dahil alam ko na expert kayo pagdating sa incentives, matagal na rin kayo sa BOI (Board of Investments), ano 'yung possible reason dito dahil ang laki ng discrepancy? Mayroon bang undervaluing of sales, hindi nagdedeklera nang tama? Base sa inyong analysis," Gatchalian asked.

(The inward remittance is about P776 million… in your experience, because you are an expert when it comes to incentives, you have been with the BOI for a long time, what is the possible reason for the large discrepancy.)
Gatchalian added that based on a submitted balance sheet, there was also P20 million in advances from shareholders. Despite this, it would still not explain the large amount, he said.

"In relation po, Honorable Judge, doon sa operations po ng kumpanya at saka po doon sa sinubmit sa aming dokumento, wala ako ng makitang rason para tumaas po sila ng more than dito po sa declared sales revenue po nila na sinubmit sa amin," Rodolfo said.
(In relation, Honorable Judge, to the operations of the company and the submitted documents, I do not see a reason for this to go higher than the declared sales revenue that was submitted to us.)
The DTI also submitted bank certifications to the impeachment court, including one in 2023 indicating $352,000 in sales or about P22.48 million with the current exchange rate.
In 2025, there was another inflow of $368,000, or about P23.5 million.
Rodolfo said this amounted to $721,283 (about P46 million). The Senate President noted that this was still far from the amount found by the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC).
Last October, AMLC Executive Director Ronel Buenaventura testified said that Cale88 had aggregate transactions amounting to P1.25 billion from 2022 to 2025.
Buenaventura also said Cale88 received P319 million from China and Hong Kong, based on AMLC's covered transaction reports (CTRs) and suspicious transaction reports (STR).
Unavailed tax incentives
Meanwhile, Gatchalian also noted that Cale88 did not avail of any tax incentives from the BOI such as the income tax holiday (ITH).

"Why go through all the trouble tapos hindi ka rin mag-a-apply ng VAT zero rating? Sabi nga kanina ni former senate president Tito Sotto, pati other incentives like ITH, 'yung customs duty exemptions, bakit hindi sila nag-apply?" Gatchalian asked, referring to value-added tax.
(Why go through all the trouble and then not apply for VAT zero rating? Former senate president Tito Sotto pointed out that other incentives like the ITH, customs exemptions, why did they not apply?)
Rodolfo explained that given that Cale88 was export-oriented, the VAT zero rating was highly competitive.
"VAT zero rating 'yung isa sa mga pinag-aawayan. It has to be very facilitative. Within that context po, hindi ko rin alam kung bakit hindi siya nag-apply," Rodolfo said.
(The VAT zero rating is fought over. It has to be very facilitative. Within that context, I do not know why they did not apply.)
— VDV, GMA News
